title: 第5章 我好像要突破了第6章 师兄要赐我法器
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
两人刚将最后一点鸡肉消灭干净。
陆鸣正打算问问林清瑶吃没吃饱。
如果没吃饱的话就再去烤一只鸡。
可就在这时，身旁的林清瑶猛的站起身，脸色泛起一丝不正常的潮红。
她周身气息不受控制地剧烈波动起来，引得周遭稀薄的灵气都产生细微的涟漪。
“师兄！”
林清瑶望向陆鸣声音带着一丝惊喜：“我……我好像要突破了！”
“突破？”
陆鸣一愣。
吃个鸡还能吃突破？
这师妹不是个天资很差的人吗？
刚刚她还是炼气十重，现在就要突破？
不等陆鸣反应，林清瑶已迅速盘膝坐下，闭目凝神。
此刻，她丹田之内正发生着翻天覆地的变化。
丹田之中缓缓旋转的气旋。
在方才那几口蕴含精纯能量的鸡肉不断注入下早已变得汹涌澎湃，达到了一个临界点！
此刻，那浓郁到极致的灵气气旋正在疯狂压缩向中心凝聚。
随后，丹田中心处一滴晶莹剔透的液态灵液凝结而出。
轰！
第一滴液态灵力出现后，整个气旋如同坍塌般向内收缩。

更多的气态灵力飞速转化为液态。
眨眼间便汇聚成一片微小的的灵液湖泊，悬浮于丹田中央。
筑基境！
一股远比炼气期雄厚精纯数倍的灵力瞬间流遍林清瑶的全身。
这股灵气冲刷着的经脉，强化着她的筋骨。
林清瑶全力运转基础法门，稳固这水到渠成的境界。
周身紊乱的气息以肉眼可见的速度平复下来。
片刻后。
林清瑶缓缓睁开眼，眸中有一道精光一闪而逝。
旋即，她看向陆鸣，神情激动万分：“多谢师兄，师妹到了筑基境！”
虽然陆鸣是个凡人。
但他也能感受到林清瑶的气场比之前强大了不少。
当即就眨了眨眼，一脸震惊。
好家伙，真突破了？
难道我这师妹，是那种看起来资质平平，但实际上是个妖孽的类型？
也就在这时，他脑海中系统的提示音响起。
【叮！
师妹林清瑶突破修为，领域增加十厘米！
陆鸣：“？？？”
十厘米？！

陆鸣直接就惊了。
content_en:
The two had just finished off the last bits of chicken.
Lu Ming was about to ask Lin Qingyao if she had eaten enough.
If you're not full, roast a chicken.
But at this moment, Lin Qingyao stood up suddenly, with an abnormal flush on her face.
The aura around her body fluctuated violently uncontrollably, causing tiny ripples in the thin spiritual energy around her.
"Brother!"
Lin Qingyao looked at Lu Ming and said with a hint of surprise in her voice: "I...I seem to be about to break through!"
"Breakthrough?"
Lu Ming was stunned.
Can you still achieve breakthroughs by eating chicken?
Isn't this junior sister a very talented person?
She was at the tenth level of Qi refining just now, and now she is about to break through?
Before Lu Ming could react, Lin Qingyao quickly sat down cross-legged, closing her eyes and concentrating.
At this moment, earth-shaking changes were taking place in her Dantian.
A slowly rotating cyclone in the dantian.
Under the continuous injection of those few bites of chicken that contained pure energy, it had already become surging and reached a critical point!
At this moment, the extremely rich spiritual energy cyclone is compressing crazily and condensing towards the center.
Then, a drop of crystal clear liquid spirit condensed out from the center of the Dantian.
boom!
After the first drop of liquid spiritual power appeared, the entire cyclone shrank inward as if it were collapsing.
More gaseous spiritual power quickly transformed into liquid state.
In the blink of an eye, it gathered into a tiny lake of spiritual fluid, suspended in the center of the dantian.
Foundation building realm!
A spiritual power that was many times stronger and purer than during the Qi refining period instantly flowed through Lin Qingyao's body.
The meridians washed by this spiritual energy strengthened her muscles and bones.
Lin Qingyao tried his best to use the basic methods to stabilize this natural state.
The chaotic atmosphere around him calmed down at a speed visible to the naked eye.
After a while.
Lin Qingyao slowly opened her eyes, and there was a flash of light in her eyes.
Immediately, she looked at Lu Ming with a very excited expression: "Thank you, senior brother, junior sister has reached the foundation building realm!"
Although Lu Ming is a mortal.
But he could also feel that Lin Qingyao's aura was much stronger than before.
He blinked immediately, looking shocked.
Good guy, have you really achieved a breakthrough?
Could it be that my junior sister is the type who seems to have mediocre qualifications, but is actually a monster?
At this moment, the system prompt sounded in his mind.
【bite!
Junior sister Lin Qingyao has achieved a breakthrough in cultivation, and her territory has increased by ten centimeters!
Lu Ming: "???"
Ten centimeters? !
Lu Ming was immediately shocked.
